Instructions:

  1. Open your Supabase project.

  2. Click SQL Editor.

  3. Click New Query.

  4. Copy the entire script below.

  5. Paste it into the editor.

  6. Click Run.

Supabase database setup

SQL

-- Run this once in Supabase Dashboard -> SQL Editor -> New query.
-- Each signed-in user can read and change ONLY their own saved plan.

create table if not exists public.email_marketing_progress (
  user_id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  data jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

alter table public.email_marketing_progress enable row level security;

grant select, insert, update on public.email_marketing_progress to authenticated;
revoke all on public.email_marketing_progress from anon;

drop policy if exists "Users can read their own email marketing progress" on public.email_marketing_progress;

create policy "Users can read their own email marketing progress"
on public.email_marketing_progress for select to authenticated
using (auth.uid() = user_id);

drop policy if exists "Users can insert their own email marketing progress" on public.email_marketing_progress;

create policy "Users can insert their own email marketing progress"
on public.email_marketing_progress for insert to authenticated
with check (auth.uid() = user_id);

drop policy if exists "Users can update their own email marketing progress" on public.email_marketing_progress;

create policy "Users can update their own email marketing progress"
on public.email_marketing_progress for update to authenticated
using (auth.uid() = user_id)
with check (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Enable Realtime for cross-device updates:
do $$
begin
  alter publication supabase_realtime add table public.email_marketing_progress;
exception
  when duplicate_object then null;
end $$;
